summary: Monday: VIX 17.94 (sub-18), SPX 7,041 ATH #8, Nasdaq 12-day streak. Iran de-escalation — Strait of Hormuz open, oil collapsed 10%. Mega-cap earnings avalanche: TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT Tuesday, META Wednesday. FOMC Apr 28-29. Q1 EPS growth +32%, 80% beat rate.

risks.label: Mega-Cap Earnings Binary Risk (Tue-Wed)
risks.detail: TSLA, GOOGL, MSFT, META report in a 48h window. Combined $10T market cap. Any major miss triggers broad market selloff. TSLA deliveries already missed consensus (358K vs 365K). Size pre-earnings trades at max 5%.

risks.label: Nasdaq 12-Day Win Streak — Overbought
risks.detail: Nasdaq has rallied 12 consecutive sessions — the longest streak since 2021. Historically, 70% of such streaks see pullback within 5 days. Extended positioning creates mean reversion risk. AutoScreener weekend reading flagged early_risk_off.

risks.label: FOMC Apr 28-29 — Rate Decision
risks.detail: Fed expected to hold at 3.50-3.75% but the statement language on inflation and rate cut timing will move markets. Hawkish surprise (no June cut signal) = growth multiple compression.

risks.label: Iran Peace Talks Fragile
risks.detail: Strait of Hormuz declared open and Trump says deal is 'very close', but talks can collapse again (as they did on Apr 13). If negotiations fail, oil spikes back above $95 and VIX targets 25+.

risks.label: SAP Q1 Report (Tue Apr 22)
risks.detail: SAP reports same day as GOOGL/TSLA. Cloud backlog growth deceleration below 20% would de-rate European software sector. Direct impact on scanner pick SAP (#6).

events.label: TSLA Q1 Earnings (Apr 22 AMC)
events.detail: Consensus EPS $0.37, Revenue $22.7B. Q1 deliveries 358K missed 365K consensus. FSD v13 progress and Energy Storage growth are the key catalysts beyond vehicle metrics.

events.label: GOOGL Q1 Earnings (Apr 22 AMC)
events.detail: Google Cloud growing 28%+ YoY, Gemini AI monetization inflection. At 25x fwd PE, trades at discount to MSFT (30x) and META (27x).

events.label: MSFT Q1 Earnings (Apr 22 PM)
events.detail: Azure re-acceleration to ~35% QoQ, Copilot AI ARPU uplift. MSFT already in open positions (+0.66%). Reports same evening as GOOGL/TSLA.

events.label: META Q1 Earnings (Apr 23 AMC)
events.detail: AI capex and ad revenue growth. META already in open positions (+2.01%). Completes the mega-cap earnings cluster.

events.label: US PMI Flash (Apr 23)
events.detail: Manufacturing + Services PMI flash reading. Growth pulse check for Q2. Below 50 = contraction signal.

events.label: Michigan Consumer Sentiment (Apr 25)
events.detail: Post-Iran de-escalation reading. Lower oil should boost consumer confidence.

opportunities.label: GOOGL Pre-Earnings — Score 91
opportunities.detail: Alphabet at 25x fwd PE reports Tuesday. Cloud growing 28%+, Gemini AI monetization. Monday is last positioning day before institutional flows accelerate.

opportunities.label: CRM at 12.5x Fwd PE — Score 89
opportunities.detail: Salesforce at multi-year valuation low. Agentforce AI platform generating $1B+ pipeline. No earnings binary risk this week (reports May). Pure value play.

opportunities.label: NFLX Post-Earnings Overreaction
opportunities.detail: Netflix fell 9% on minor Q2 guidance miss despite beating Q1 revenue ($12.25B +16% YoY). Net income +83%, FCF +91%. Contrarian pullback opportunity at 24.6x fwd PE.

opportunities.label: IGV Software ETF Breakout
opportunities.detail: iShares Software ETF was strongest performer Friday (+1.43%). Above 50-DMA, breaking out. Captures AI enterprise SaaS wave without single-stock earnings risk.

opportunities.label: Iran De-escalation Consumer Plays
opportunities.detail: Oil collapse (-10%) is direct tailwind for consumer spending. V, XLY, SPOT, SE all benefit from lower gas prices and reduced inflation pressure.

regime_blips.label: VIX sub-18 — Risk-On Confirmed
regime_blips.detail: VIX at 17.94 for multiple sessions. Institutional volatility sellers dominant. Sub-18 is the maximum bullish signal in our framework.

regime_blips.label: DXY 98.21 — Weak Dollar Tailwind
regime_blips.detail: Dollar weakness supports multinational earnings (GOOGL, SAP, SPOT) and EM markets (SE). Direct FX tailwind for Q2 guidance.

regime_blips.label: Disinflation Confirmed — PPI Miss
regime_blips.detail: PPI March +0.5% vs +1.1% expected. Confirms disinflation trend supporting June rate cut thesis. Enterprise IT budgets expand when inflation recedes.

regime_blips.label: Q1 Earnings Exceptional
regime_blips.detail: 80% EPS beat rate, +32% YoY growth, 69% revenue beat. Equity valuations getting cheaper as earnings revisions rise.
